label: Text pressure
desc: Letters squash, thicken and warm toward the primary colour under a press that follows the pointer and deepens while held.
use: Hero words or section titles that should react to touch and hover.

label: True focus
desc: A sentence where one word is sharp inside a bracketed focus frame that glides between words while the others blur.
use: Hero statements and feature one-liners where words are taken in one at a time.

label: Variable proximity
desc: Each letter blends from a light sans to a heavy italic serif by its distance to the pointer, without reflowing the line.
use: Large display headings that invite the pointer.

label: Warp text
desc: Text on a rippling baseline with a fisheye lens that swells, spreads and tilts the letters around the pointer.
use: Playful hero words, landing-page splashes and 404 headings.

label: Typography vortex
desc: Concentric rings of letters whirl around a centre; the pointer pulls letters in and a click sends a shockwave through the rings.
use: Decorative hero background or empty-state art (fills its parent).

label: Semantic bloom
desc: A wordmark that blooms into related words on gooey liquid bridges; choosing a word makes it the new centre. Accepts your own word graph.
use: Topic or tag explorers, brand-word hero sections (fills its parent).

label: Text path studies
desc: Five Canvas2D studies of text set along paths: a draggable letter globe, a pointer-lifted cloth, ripples through rows, a bouncing spiral ball and a morphing path.
use: Showcase sections and creative portfolios; pick one study with the variant prop (fills its parent).

label: Gallery heading
desc: A heading over a 3D ring of generated print-style tiles (flat, grain, dither, halftone, glitch, noise); it turns by itself, by buttons, keys or drag.
use: Portfolio or collection intro sections (fills its parent).

label: Article headings
desc: Four editorial heading treatments in one component: decode from noise, neon sign power-up, particle assembly and an equaliser backdrop.
use: Article, blog and campaign headings; choose a treatment with the variant prop.
